tools.name: get_price_history
tools.when_to_use: See how an offer's price changed over time (points, cursor paginated). Chart trends or find when a price moved.
tools.when_not_to_use: You only want the current price (use the offer service).

tools.name: get_price_stats
tools.when_to_use: Get min/max/avg/last UAH price for an offer over a range to judge whether the current price is good.
tools.when_not_to_use: You need the full series of points (use get_price_history).

tools.name: get_price_daily
tools.when_to_use: Get an offer's per-day UAH-price rollup (min/max/avg/last per day) to chart a daily price trend.
tools.when_not_to_use: You want overall stats (use get_price_stats) or every raw point (use get_price_history).
